Our clients at the Department of Transportation are very pleased with the website you designed for them. lt's just what they wanted, so congratulations!
Now, when thei representatives were here last, some of you complained that you couldn't meet with them in our conference room because of the remodeling work in the room. l'm sorry, l know that's a problem, but the renovation project should be finished very soon.
Meanwhile, no one ever uses the empty office upstairs. l think we just need to move in a few extra chairs and a table. l'll do that this afternoon.

我们交通部的客户对您为他们设计的网站非常满意。这正是他们想要的，所以恭喜您！
上次他们的代表来的时候，一些人抱怨说因为会议室正在进行翻修工作，无法在我们的会议室会见他们。我很抱歉，我知道这是一个问题，但这个装修项目很快就会完成。
与此同时，楼上的空办公室从来没有人使用过。我想我们只需要搬进去几把额外的椅子和一张桌子。我今天下午就做这件事。
